title: Credit Tier Note: Seasoned-Contract Points on a Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Late-Posted Installment Charge
content:
**Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract — contract age and credit tier.**

**Rule.** When at least 24 whole calendar months have passed from the contract date to today and the contract is on Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+, Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 or Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2, 0.5 percentage points are taken off the late-posted rate; when at least 24 whole months have passed on any other tier, 0.25 points are taken off; in every other case no points are taken off.

**Counting.** Whole calendar months from one date to a later one are the difference in month numbers, less one when the later date's day number is smaller than the earlier date's, with no month-end adjustment. The points come off the late-posted rate that applies to the contract, which is then applied once to one monthly payment.

| Tier | 24 or more whole months since the contract date | Fewer than 24 |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1+ | 0.5 | 0 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 1 | 0.5 | 0 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 2 | 0.5 | 0 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 3 | 0.25 | 0 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 4 | 0.25 | 0 |
| Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Tier 5 | 0.25 | 0 |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical):* contract date the 18th of a month; today the 18th of the month 24 months later: 24 whole months. Today the 17th of that month: 23 whole months, no points.
